description: Source code for QuicChromiumPacketReader class handling UDP packet reading, including support for multiple packet reads on specific platforms, with functions for starting reads, processing results, and notifying visitors.

classes.name: QuicChromiumPacketReader
classes.description: Handles reading UDP packets for QUIC, supporting multiple packets reading on specific platforms, and notifying a visitor about received packets or errors.

methods.name: QuicChromiumPacketReader
methods.description: Constructor initializing the packet reader with socket, clock, visitor, and logging parameters.

methods.name: StartReadingMultiplePackets
methods.description: Attempts to read multiple packets if platform supports; falls back if not.

methods.name: ProcessMultiplePacketReadResult
methods.description: Processes the result of a multiple packet read, handling errors and invoking visitor callbacks.

methods.name: OnReadMultiplePacketComplete
methods.description: Callback invoked upon completion of multiple packet read, triggers re-reading if successful.

methods.name: StartReading
methods.description: Begins reading packets, either multiple or single, based on platform support.

methods.name: ProcessReadResult
methods.description: Processes the result of a single read, handling errors, creating packets, and notifying visitor.

methods.name: OnReadComplete
methods.description: Callback invoked upon completion of a single read, triggers next read if successful.
